explanation: Elastic collision between two circles with e=1 creates energy. Just before contact (step 155) energy equals initial 1998.4 J, with bodies barely separated (gap 0.017). At step 156 collision resolves to 2261.85 J, exceeding allowed limit 2203.24 J despite zero gravity and disabled controller. Lowering restitution to 0.9 removes violation, indicating impulse/positional-correction code adds energy in the perfectly elastic case.
